(ii)  In the event of an employee not availing himself of his full quota of sick leave, he may carry forward his leave,
which he could use in the event of hospitalization or a prolonged illness in a succeeding year, subject to the
condition however that he cannot avail himself of more than 90 days on that account.
(iii) In the case of an employee whose terms presently permit him a higher quantum of sick leave he shall be permitted
